name: channel remap
about: channel from 2 to 1 moves every channel message on channel 2 onto channel 1 and leaves the rest alone.
notes: Channels in op arguments are 1 to 16, as bay.mjs writes them. On the wire channel 2 is low nibble 1 and channel 1 is low nibble 0.
91 to 90, B1 to B0, E1 to E0, 81 to 80, D1 to D0: the status changes and the data bytes do not.
NEGATIVE CONTROL: 92 is channel 3, which the op does not match, so it passes as 92.
NEGATIVE CONTROL: F8 has no channel, so it passes as F8.
